name: willow
lore_descriptor: pale, almost silvery — bends in a strong breeze
unidentified_descriptor: a slender, pale length of wood
first_pickup_chronicle: Willow. Bends instead of breaks. Bowers love it for that — and so do magicians. The wood seems to listen.
design_notes: Band A light-enchantable wood. Low mult (0.75), very light (0.65), max_enchant 4. The wood-class equivalent of tin. Fills Band A wood-light gap so clubs/staves/bows have variety early.
